mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 65 degrees. If you look to the sky at 7:37 PM, you can catch the ISS passing from the West Northwest over Cross Plains toward the Northeast near Madison for five minutes. Expect an overnight low of 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city is continuing work on the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth. Additionally, the police department is currently accepting applications for new patrol officers who are interested in community oriented policing and professional development.

There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus Trivia this evening. Tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival starting this Friday.

Regarding the recent police report, on September 5th, an officer responded to a report of vehicles having cheese slices placed on their windshields in several areas around town, which officers identified as a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM, however, they are closed today for a building remodel, so keep an eye out for their reopening.
